# pLLM (`pllm` — Programmable LLM)
> Declarative programmability layer for running stateful and adaptive inference-time PyTorch algorithms inside unmodified vLLM (0.27–0.34) under continuous batching, CUDA graphs, and per-request paged state management.

## Coding Agent Entry Points (Read These First)
- [SKILL.md](doc/agent/SKILL.md): Core workflow, declarations, `explain` -> `testing.check` -> `make_llm` / `make_async_llm`
- [migration.md](doc/agent/migration.md): Pre-flight audit and translation from HF hooks / `LogitsProcessor` / PEFT / PyTorch TTT loops to `pllm.Workload`
- [reference.md](doc/agent/reference.md): Task-indexed API guide + generated signatures for every public symbol
- [examples.md](doc/agent/examples.md): Nearest maintained example per algorithm family
- [rules.md](doc/agent/rules.md): Invariants, refused combinations, engine/model/CUDA-graph support matrix, explicit cost choices
- [pitfalls.md](doc/agent/pitfalls.md): Error catalog (`errors.toml` generated), anti-patterns, silent traps, shapes & dtypes

Or via CLI after `pip install pllm`: `pllm skill --print` or `pllm skill --install claude|codex|cursor`.
